title: Corporate culture
objectives: understand basic office dynamics and collocations
talk about work hours, teams, and projects

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Greet student and introduce lesson objectives for Corporate culture.
Welcome to today's lesson: Corporate culture! Today we will practice how to understand basic office dynamics and collocations.

elements.content: understand basic office dynamics and collocations; talk about work hours, teams, and projects

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Introduce target vocabulary and key language structures using concept check questions.

elements.content: Review key terms and target language below:
Key terms: work_hours, team, colleague, meeting, project, corporate

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Check understanding through controlled choice exercise.

elements.content: What do colleagues discuss in the corporate culture reading text?

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Develop reading comprehension and listening skills.

teacherNotes.title: Listening Tapescript
teacherNotes.content: Our corporate team has a meeting at ten. We work together on an important project.

elements.content: Read the short passage below (recycling introduced vocabulary):
In corporate culture, team colleagues meet every morning. We discuss work hours, projects, and meetings.
Listening Task: Listen to your teacher / audio prompt and answer the comprehension question.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Provide communicative speaking practice and personalized interaction.

elements.content: Describe your office or study team protocol and meeting schedules.

teacherNotes.title: Stage aim
teacherNotes.content: Review key corrections and confirm homework task.
Great work today! Remember to review target words in your mobile app before our next class.

elements.content: Today you practiced: understand basic office dynamics and collocations, talk about work hours, teams, and projects.
